purpose: Explicit per-session GPU operation receipts and fail-closed stage-coverage accounting
result: passed bounded correctness and compatibility checks; strict GPU admission remains disabled
limitations: Device calls count executor operations or successful aggregate transform/hash intervals, not individual kernel launches; device nanoseconds exclude wall and transfer time.

Stage receipts prove completed selected operations, not absence of host arithmetic. Mixed public-value/preprocessing capabilities and the upstream prover envelope keep stage coverage incomplete and strict admission disabled.
Host-input, non-captured and experimental paths can have partial receipts. Complete runtime fallback enforcement and whole-request coverage composition remain future work.
Owned main/quotient commitment remains single-AIR; wallet and batch Rust/C ABI paths are not fully GPU-backed.
Native qualification covers bounded NVIDIA OpenCL correctness on one laptop GPU; AMD/Metal and sustained multi-worker transaction throughput are unqualified.
Pending Apple source must arrive through the authorized local Mac checkpoint commit; no SSH attempted.
